name: ClassicDB 1.0-beta.2
body:
# ClassicDB Beta 2

### Notes
*This is a beta version. Some minor bugs are to be expected. You can post any feedback you want to the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/Muehe/classicdb/issues). If you want to report a bug please make sure it is not yet reported there or listed in the [Know Issues](https://github.com/Muehe/classicdb/wiki#known-issues).*

### Installation
For installation instructions see the [Readme](https://github.com/Muehe/classicdb/blob/master/README.md#installation).

### Changes since last version
See the [Changelog](https://github.com/Muehe/classicdb/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#classicdb-10-beta2-2017-05-21).
